parsed.name: RGB三色发光二极管
parsed.description: 一种通过 GPIO 控制红、绿、蓝三个通道的全彩发光二极管，可设置颜色、通道强度以及闪烁和渐亮渐暗效果，常用于状态指示、视觉提示和教学实验。
parsed.description_en: A full-color LED component controlled through GPIO with separate red, green, and blue channels. It supports color setting, channel intensity control, blinking, and pulsing, and is commonly used for status indication, visual feedback, and teaching experiments.
